name: PowerUp
summary: Brisbane ISP, began as a community BBS (Morningside, Lloyd Ernst); became Qld's largest ISP; spun off WebCentral; sold to OzEmail (POWER UP PTY LTD, ACN 068 604 955).

events.details: Major early Queensland ISP; earliest Wayback capture of powerup.com.au.

Sold to OzEmail; PowerUp split and WebCentral was formed. The PowerUp brand survived the 1998/2000 OzEmail takeovers and was still served in Oct 2003, so death is c. 2003 — later than both the current 1999 and the proposed 1999-2000.

refs.label: AFR, 31 Mar 2000: OzEmail took 100% of PowerUp (55% bought 1998) but kept operating the brand.
The PowerUp-branded homepage was still being served on 1 Oct 2003 under OzEmail; no 2004+ content captures.
By May 2010 the domain 301'd to iiNet (iiNet acquired OzEmail in 2005).
